item.text: The return-order failure exposes the cause of the connection resets too: creating a task chose its next position from tasks currently in the project. A project can have a higher remembered position left by a task that moved away, so the insert hit the unique position constraint and crashed that request. I’m changing new-task placement to use the highest position ever established for that project.
